title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཙ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 96)
shelf_note: Derge woodblock folio of a Madhyamaka commentary on Mulamadhyamakakarika ch. 7 (abiding/sthiti of the conditioned), correctly shelved in the dbu ma section.

pages.prefer_reason: Both versions render every sentence and verse of the folio faithfully with only minor slips (an opaque page-initial fragment, a passivised verse line); neither has a serious or moderate error the other avoids.

book_verdict: A clean Derge folio with near-complete OCR and two faithful English versions of the MMK ch. 7 commentary on abiding; nothing an expert would flag on sight beyond stray '#' uncertainty markers.
